title: Recycled inactive driver registration inherits stale initialized flag
summary: New/recycled registration starts uninitialized, and successful removal clears the flag; refused shutdown preserves initialized state. Exact inactive replacement, failed-init and legacy loader controls pass normally and under sanitizers.
evidence: Reproducer and exact command/result in task findings.md; indigo_libs/indigo_client.c add_driver and indigo_remove_driver at baseline e5e77e58edd20f102577a8f931651f802bdfc612.
